name: App

description.zh: 为窗口设置主题，并传给其中的组件。
description.en: Apply a window theme and share it with its components.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

在视图函数开头调用 `nui.App(c, config)`，再把返回的主题传给按钮、卡片等组件。`config` 保存明暗模式和色板，应在创建窗口时初始化。页面中的完整示例包含窗口创建和语言设置。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 修改按钮文字和颜色，观察卡片中的按钮。
2. 切换页面右上角的明暗模式，查看同一组组件的配色。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Call `nui.App(c, config)` at the start of the view and pass its theme to buttons, cards and other components. Initialize `config` when creating the window to keep appearance and palette choices. The complete example includes window and language setup.

### Try the preview

1. Change the button text and color inside the card.
2. Switch the site appearance to compare light and dark colors.

note.zh: App 只配置当前窗口的主题。创建窗口仍需调用 `mygo.NewWindow`。
note.en: App configures the current window theme. Create the window with `mygo.NewWindow`.

body: nui.Card(c.Key("card"), t, nui.CardOptions{Title: "NuxtUI Go", Description: "Window theme and component defaults"}, func() { nui.Button(c.Key("save"), t, {{label}}, nui.ButtonOptions{AccessibleLabel: cmp.Or({{label}}, "Example action"), Color: {{color}}}) })

name: Theme

description.zh: 统一设置颜色、尺寸和组件样式。
description.en: Set shared colors, sizes and component styles.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

`Theme` 保存颜色、字号、间距和组件默认样式。用 `WithComponent` 设置一类组件的默认值；在具体组件的 Options 中设置属性，可覆盖对应默认值。`UI` 用于修改圆角等部件样式。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 调整颜色、尺寸和样式：第一个按钮使用局部默认值，第二个按钮始终使用 Warning 颜色，第三个展示自定义圆角。
2. 把主色改为 black，再切换明暗模式，查看黑白主色。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

`Theme` holds colors, typography, spacing and component defaults. Use `WithComponent` to set defaults for a component type, Options to override them on one instance, and `UI` to customize individual parts.

### Try the preview

1. Change color, size and variant: the first button uses local defaults, the second keeps its Warning color, and the third has custom rounded corners.
2. Select black as the primary color, then switch between light and dark mode.

note.zh: 黑白主色通过 `WithBlackPrimary()` 配置：浅色为黑，深色为白，高对比模式下也保持黑白。应分别应用到浅色和深色主题。
note.en: Apply `WithBlackPrimary()` to both themes for black in light mode and white in dark mode, including high contrast.

body:
local := t.WithComponent(nui.ComponentButton, nui.ComponentTheme{Color: {{color}}, Size: {{size}}, Variant: {{variant}}})
nui.Button(c.Key("local"), local, "Local theme", nui.ButtonOptions{})
nui.Button(c.Key("override"), local, "Instance override", nui.ButtonOptions{Color: nui.Warning})
nui.Button(c.Key("parts"), t, "Part style override", nui.ButtonOptions{UI:nui.Styles{nui.Root:{Radius:nui.Set(float32(999)),PaddingX:nui.Set(float32(24))}}}).AlignSelf(ui.Start)

name: Container

description.zh: 限制内容宽度，并在两侧留出空间。
description.en: Limit content width and add space around it.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

把页面内容放入 `Container` 的回调中，用 `MaxWidth` 限制最大宽度，用 `Padding` 设置内边距。尺寸使用 DIP（逻辑像素），通常不需要手动乘屏幕缩放比例。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 减小最大宽度，观察卡片占用的宽度。
2. 调整内边距；设为 0 后，查看内容与容器边缘的距离。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Build the page content inside `Container`. Set `MaxWidth` to limit its width and `Padding` for inner spacing. Dimensions use DIP, so applications usually do not need to apply screen scaling themselves.

### Try the preview

1. Reduce the maximum width and watch the card become narrower.
2. Change the padding, then set it to 0 to remove the inner spacing.

note.zh: `nui.Set(0)` 表示明确使用 0；未设置 Optional 字段时，组件使用默认值。
note.en: `nui.Set(0)` explicitly uses zero. An unset Optional field uses the component default.

body: nui.Container(c.Key("container"), t, nui.ContainerOptions{MaxWidth: nui.Set(float32({{width}})), Padding: nui.Set(float32({{padding}}))}, func() { nui.Card(c.Key("card"), t, nui.CardOptions{Title:"Contained content"}, func(){ ui.Text(c,"Resize the browser to see the width constraint.") }) })

description.zh: 放置应用的主要内容，并占用剩余空间。
description.en: Place the main application content in the available space.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

在 `Main` 的内容回调中创建页面主体，可与 HeaderLayout、Sidebar 和 FooterLayout 组合。回调会随界面更新而重复执行，业务数据应保存在视图函数外。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 修改标题，查看主内容区中的卡片。
2. 打开完整示例，查看 Main 与窗口主题的组合方式。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Build the main page content in the `Main` callback and combine it with HeaderLayout, Sidebar and FooterLayout. The callback runs again as the UI updates, so keep application data outside the view function.

### Try the preview

1. Change the title on the card in the main content area.
2. Open the complete example to see Main used with a window theme.

note.zh: Main 提供布局，不会自动增加滚动条。内容需要滚动时，再组合 ScrollArea 或 MyGo 的 Scroll。
note.en: Main provides layout without scrolling. Add ScrollArea or MyGo Scroll when content needs to scroll.

description.zh: 显示 Lucide 矢量图标。
description.en: Display a Lucide vector icon.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

从 `icons/lucide` 包选择图标函数，例如 `lucide.Check()`，将返回的 SVG 传给 `nui.Icon`。通过 Size 设置显示大小，具有独立含义的图标应提供 Label，供辅助技术识别。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 选择不同图标，查看 SVG 的形状。
2. 调整图标大小，观察缩放后的清晰度。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Choose a function from `icons/lucide`, such as `lucide.Check()`, and pass its SVG to `nui.Icon`. Size controls the displayed dimensions. Give a meaningful standalone icon a Label for assistive technology.

### Try the preview

1. Choose a different icon to compare SVG shapes.
2. Change the icon size to see how it scales.

note.zh: 图标大小使用 DIP。图标函数返回共享 SVG，颜色和尺寸通过组件设置，不直接修改 SVG。
note.en: Icon size uses DIP. Icon functions return shared SVGs; set color and size on the component rather than modifying the SVG.

name: Button

description.zh: 点击后执行操作，支持图标、加载和禁用状态。
description.en: Run an action with support for icons, loading and disabled states.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

用 `Button` 设置文字和外观，通过 `.OnClick(...)` 处理点击。点击次数等业务数据放在视图函数外；Loading 和 Disabled 都会阻止用户激活按钮。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 点击按钮，查看下方计数增加。
2. 更换图标、颜色或尺寸，确认已有计数仍然保留。
3. 开启加载或禁用，再点击按钮，查看计数是否停止变化。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Set button text and appearance with `Button`, then handle activation with `.OnClick(...)`. Keep values such as a click count outside the view function. Loading and Disabled both prevent activation.

### Try the preview

1. Click the button and watch the count below it increase.
2. Change its icon, color or size and confirm the count is retained.
3. Enable loading or disabled, then click again to check that the count stays the same.

note.zh: 仅显示图标的按钮必须设置 `AccessibleLabel`，说明按钮的用途。重置示例会清除点击计数。
note.en: An icon-only button requires an `AccessibleLabel` describing its action. Resetting the example clears the click count.

body:
nui.Button(c.Key("button"), t, {{label}}, nui.ButtonOptions{AccessibleLabel: cmp.Or({{label}}, "Example action"), Color: {{color}}, Size: {{size}}, Variant: {{variant}}, Disabled: {{disabled}}, Loading: {{loading}}, Leading: {{icon}}}).AlignSelf(ui.Start).OnClick(func(){s.Clicks++})
ui.Textf(c,"Clicked %d times",s.Clicks)

name: Link

description.zh: 以链接样式打开地址或执行导航。
description.en: Open a URL or navigate with a link.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

需要打开外部地址时设置 URL；应用内导航可通过返回元素的 `.OnClick(...)` 处理。Active 标记当前位置，Disabled 禁止操作。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 点击链接，查看下方的操作次数。
2. 切换当前项和禁用状态，比较外观及点击行为。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Set URL to open an external address, or use `.OnClick(...)` on the returned element for application navigation. Active marks the current location and Disabled prevents activation.

### Try the preview

1. Click the link and check the activation count below it.
2. Toggle active and disabled states to compare appearance and behavior.

note.zh: 本例只增加计数，不打开网页。真实导航由 URL 或应用回调决定。
note.en: This example only increments a count. Use URL or an application callback for actual navigation.

body:
nui.Link(c.Key("link"), t, {{label}}, nui.LinkOptions{Color: {{color}}, Disabled: {{disabled}}, Active: {{active}}}).OnClick(func(){s.Clicks++})
ui.Textf(c,"Activated %d times",s.Clicks)

description.zh: 用短标签显示状态、分类或数量。
description.en: Show a status, category or count as a small label.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

将要显示的短文字传给 `Badge`，通过 Color、Variant 和 Size 选择外观。Leading 和 Trailing 可在文字两侧添加图标。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 修改标签文字，再选择颜色和图标。
2. 切换样式与方形选项，比较带文字和仅图标的效果。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Pass a short label to `Badge` and choose Color, Variant and Size. Leading and Trailing add icons before or after the text.

### Try the preview

1. Change the label, then choose a color and icon.
2. Compare variants and the square option with text or an icon alone.

note.zh: Badge 用于显示信息。需要点击执行操作时，使用 Button。
note.en: Badge displays information. Use Button when the user needs to perform an action.

name: Card

description.zh: 把标题、说明和相关内容放在同一张卡片中。
description.en: Group a title, description and related content in a card.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

Title 和 Description 设置卡片标题及说明，内容回调用于添加正文和按钮。需要定制标题区或底部操作区时，使用 Header 和 Footer 回调。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 修改标题，查看卡片顶部的变化。
2. 切换 Variant，比较边框和背景样式。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Use Title and Description for the heading, and the content callback for the body and buttons. Header and Footer callbacks customize the heading area and footer.

### Try the preview

1. Change the title at the top of the card.
2. Switch Variant to compare borders and backgrounds.

note.zh: 示例中的 Continue 按钮只展示布局，没有绑定业务操作。
note.en: The Continue button demonstrates the layout and has no application action attached.

body: nui.Card(c.Key("card"),t,nui.CardOptions{Title:{{label}},Description:"A native Go component",Variant:{{variant}}},func(){ui.Text(c,"A focused space for related content.");nui.Button(c.Key("action"),t,"Continue",nui.ButtonOptions{})})

description.zh: 在内容区域显示提示、警告或错误信息。
description.en: Display an inline message, warning or error.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

用 Title、Description 和 Icon 说明当前状态，再用 Color 区分普通提示、成功、警告或错误。需要操作按钮时，可通过 Actions 添加。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 修改标题、颜色和样式，比较提示的外观。
2. 切换方向，查看正文与可选操作区的排列设置。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Describe the status with Title, Description and Icon, and use Color for information, success, warning or error. Add action buttons through Actions when needed.

### Try the preview

1. Change the title, color and variant to compare message styles.
2. Change orientation to compare the layout setting for the body and optional actions.

note.zh: 本例的说明文字固定，未添加操作按钮；方向主要决定操作区位于正文下方还是旁边。
note.en: This example has a fixed description and no action buttons. Orientation mainly controls whether actions sit below or beside the body.

description.zh: 显示头像图片、图标或姓名首字母。
description.en: Display an image, icon or name initials as an avatar.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

将姓名传给 Alt，可生成首字母头像。设置 Text 时会原样显示该文字，例如 `+12`；也可传入已解码的图片或 SVG 图标。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 输入不同姓名，查看自动生成的首字母。
2. 调整颜色和尺寸，比较头像外观。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Pass a name through Alt to display initials. Text is shown literally, for example `+12`. You can also supply a decoded image or an SVG icon.

### Try the preview

1. Enter different names to see their initials.
2. Change color and size to compare avatar styles.

note.zh: Avatar 不负责下载或读取图片。应用应先完成图片加载，再把资源传给组件。
note.en: Avatar does not download or read images. Load the image in the application before passing it to the component.

description.zh: 排列多个头像，并显示未展开的人数。
description.en: Arrange several avatars and show how many remain hidden.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

为每个 AvatarItem 提供稳定、唯一的用户 ID 和头像配置。Max 限制显示数量，超出的头像用 `+n` 表示；Size 和 Color 为未单独配置的头像提供默认值。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 将显示上限设为 1 或 2，观察剩余人数。
2. 调整尺寸和颜色，查看三个示例头像的组合效果。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Give each AvatarItem a stable, unique user ID and avatar options. Max limits the visible avatars and represents the rest as `+n`. Size and Color supply defaults for items without their own settings.

### Try the preview

1. Set the visible limit to 1 or 2 and check the remaining count.
2. Change size and color to compare the three sample avatars.

note.zh: Max 未设置或小于等于 0 时显示全部头像。动态用户列表使用用户 ID，避免使用排序后会变化的下标。
note.en: An unset Max or a value at or below zero shows all avatars. Use user IDs rather than positions in a sortable list.

description.zh: 在头像等内容的角落添加数量或状态标记。
description.en: Add a count or status marker to the corner of other content.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

在 `Chip` 的内容回调中创建头像等主体，通过 Text、Color 和位置选项配置角标。Hidden 只隐藏角标，保留主体内容。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 修改标记文字和颜色，查看头像角落的变化。
2. 开启隐藏，确认头像仍然显示。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Build an avatar or other content inside `Chip`, then configure its marker with Text, Color and position options. Hidden removes the marker while keeping the main content.

### Try the preview

1. Change the marker text and color on the avatar.
2. Enable hidden and confirm that the avatar remains visible.

note.zh: 角标不会拦截主体的点击。数量或在线状态需要被屏幕阅读器读出时，应用应将它写入主体的名称或说明。
note.en: The marker does not intercept clicks. Include meaningful counts or status in the host control’s name or description for screen readers.

description.zh: 用分隔线区分内容，可添加文字或图标。
description.en: Separate content with a line, label or icon.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

通过 Orientation 选择横线或竖线，Label 在分隔线中显示文字。Size 调整线宽，Color 设置颜色；实际长度由容器和组件尺寸决定。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 修改文字和颜色，查看分隔线中间的内容。
2. 切换方向，再调整尺寸，比较线条的方向与粗细。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Use Orientation for a horizontal or vertical line and Label to insert text. Size adjusts line thickness and Color sets its color. The container and component dimensions determine its length.

### Try the preview

1. Change the label and color in the divider.
2. Switch orientation and size to compare direction and thickness.

description.zh: 把快捷键显示为按键提示。
description.en: Display a keyboard shortcut as key labels.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

将按键名称按顺序传给 `Kbd`，例如 `[]string{"Ctrl", "K"}`。组件会按平台习惯显示键名，Size 和 Variant 控制提示外观。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 查看 Ctrl + K 的按键提示。
2. 调整尺寸、颜色和样式，比较提示外观。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Pass key names in order, such as `[]string{"Ctrl", "K"}`. Kbd formats them for the platform, while Size and Variant control their appearance.

### Try the preview

1. Look at the Ctrl + K key labels.
2. Change size, color and variant to compare their appearance.

note.zh: Kbd 只显示提示，不注册快捷键。实际按键操作需由应用单独绑定。
note.en: Kbd displays a hint; it does not register the shortcut. Bind keyboard actions separately in the application.

description.zh: 在数据加载时显示内容占位。
description.en: Show a placeholder while content is loading.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

用 Width、Height 和圆角设置占位块的大小与形状，应用根据加载状态决定是否显示。Skeleton 本身不发起数据请求。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 修改宽度和高度，模拟不同内容的占位。
2. 关闭动画，再开启动画，对比静态和动态效果。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Set Width, Height and radius to match the expected content. The application decides when to show it based on loading state; Skeleton does not fetch data.

### Try the preview

1. Change width and height to match different kinds of content.
2. Turn animation off and on to compare a static and animated placeholder.

note.zh: 系统或主题启用减少动态效果时，Skeleton 保持静止。
note.en: Skeleton stays still when the system or theme requests reduced motion.

description.zh: 显示已完成的进度，或表示任务仍在处理中。
description.en: Show completed progress or indicate that work is ongoing.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

已知完成量时，向 `Progress` 传入数值，并按需设置 Max。无法确定进度时，启用 Indeterminate；应用在任务有新结果时更新数值。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 调整进度数值，观察填充长度。
2. 开启进度未知，查看不确定进度的显示，再切换方向。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Pass a numeric value to `Progress` when the amount completed is known, and set Max if needed. Enable Indeterminate when progress cannot be measured. Update the value as the task advances.

### Try the preview

1. Change the value and watch the filled length.
2. Enable indeterminate progress, then switch orientation.

note.zh: 本例由参数直接设置数值，不会启动真实任务。
note.en: The controls set the value directly; this example does not start a task.

description.zh: 在同一条进度轨道中展示多项完成量。
description.en: Show several amounts within one progress track.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

为每个 ProgressSegment 设置 ID、Label、Value 和 Color。组件将各段画在同一轨道中，未达到 Max 时保留空余；说明列表展示各段占比。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 查看 Code、Tests、Docs 三段固定数据。
2. 切换隐藏图例和排列方向，比较进度条与说明列表。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Set ID, Label, Value and Color for each ProgressSegment. Segments share one track, with unused space below Max. The legend shows each segment’s share.

### Try the preview

1. Compare the fixed Code, Tests and Docs segments.
2. Toggle the legend and orientation to compare the track and labels.

note.zh: 各段需要唯一、非空 ID。组件负责展示，任务调度和进度计算由应用处理。
note.en: Each segment needs a unique, non-empty ID. The application schedules tasks and calculates their progress.

description.zh: 说明当前为何没有内容，并提供下一步操作。
description.en: Explain an empty state and offer a next action.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

用 Title、Description 和 Icon 解释空状态，通过 Actions 添加创建、刷新等操作。Loading 可以在同一区域显示加载状态。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 修改标题、尺寸和样式，查看空状态的排版。
2. 开启加载，比较加载中和没有内容时的显示。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Explain the empty state with Title, Description and Icon. Add actions such as create or refresh through Actions. Loading can show a loading state in the same area.

### Try the preview

1. Change the title, size and variant to compare the layout.
2. Enable loading to compare loading and empty states.

note.zh: 本例的 Create project 按钮未绑定创建操作，应用需要自行实现创建流程。
note.en: The Create project button has no action attached. Implement the creation flow in the application.

description.zh: 一起显示用户头像、姓名和简短说明。
description.en: Show a user’s avatar, name and short description.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

将姓名传给 Name，角色或说明传给 Description，头像通过 Avatar 配置。需要点击打开用户资料时，可提供 OnActivate。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 修改姓名，查看文字和首字母头像同时更新。
2. 切换纵向排列，并调整尺寸。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Use Name for the person’s name, Description for a role or short note, and Avatar for their image or initials. Supply OnActivate to open a profile or perform another action.

### Try the preview

1. Change the name and watch both the text and initials update.
2. Switch to vertical layout and adjust the size.

note.zh: 本例明确设置了 Avatar.Alt 来显示首字母。Avatar 配置全为空时，User 不显示头像。
note.en: This example sets Avatar.Alt to show initials. User shows no avatar when all Avatar options are empty.

name: Input

description.zh: 编辑单行文字，支持只读、清空和加载状态。
description.en: Edit one line of text with read-only, clear and loading options.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

将字符串指针传给 `Input`，组件会更新绑定的值。字符串应保存在视图函数外，避免每次界面更新都重置输入。Label 提供控件名称，Placeholder 是输入前的提示。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 输入一段文字，查看下方的 Value。
2. 调整尺寸、主题或网站语言，确认输入仍保留。
3. 开启只读后尝试选择和复制，再开启禁用比较操作差异。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Pass a string pointer to `Input`; the component updates that value. Keep the string outside the view function so UI updates do not reset it. Label names the control and Placeholder gives an input hint.

### Try the preview

1. Enter some text and check Value below the input.
2. Change size, theme or site language and confirm the text remains.
3. Enable read-only and try selecting or copying, then compare with disabled.

note.zh: ReadOnly 允许选择和复制，但禁止编辑；Disabled 禁止交互。Loading 显示加载图标，输入框仍可编辑。
note.en: ReadOnly allows selection and copying but prevents editing. Disabled prevents interaction. Loading shows an indicator while allowing editing.

body:
nui.Input(c.Key("input"),t,&s.Value,nui.InputOptions{Label: {{label}}, Placeholder: {{placeholder}}, Color: {{color}}, Size: {{size}}, Variant: {{variant}}, Disabled: {{disabled}}, ReadOnly: {{readOnly}}, Loading: {{loading}}})
ui.Textf(c,"Value: %s",s.Value)

name: Textarea

description.zh: 编辑多行文字，可随内容增加高度。
description.en: Edit multiple lines and optionally grow with the content.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

Textarea 绑定字符串，通用输入选项放在嵌入的 InputOptions 中。Rows 设置基础行数，AutoResize 允许随换行增长，MaxRows 可限制最高行数。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 输入多行文字，调整基础行数。
2. 开启自动调整高度，继续换行并观察输入框高度。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Textarea binds a string and takes shared input settings through InputOptions. Rows sets the base line count, AutoResize grows with new lines, and MaxRows can cap that growth.

### Try the preview

1. Enter several lines and change the base row count.
2. Enable automatic height, then add more lines and watch the field grow.

note.zh: 文字保存在视图函数外。改变行数或外观不会重新初始化内容。
note.en: Keep the text outside the view function. Changing row count or appearance does not reinitialize it.

body: nui.Textarea(c.Key("textarea"),t,&s.Value,nui.TextareaOptions{InputOptions:nui.InputOptions{Label: {{label}}, Placeholder: {{placeholder}}, Color: {{color}}, Size: {{size}}, Variant: {{variant}}, Disabled: {{disabled}}, ReadOnly: {{readOnly}}, Loading: {{loading}}},Rows:{{rows}},AutoResize:{{autoResize}}})

name: FormField

description.zh: 给输入控件添加标签、帮助文字和错误提示。
description.en: Add a label, help text and errors to an input.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

把输入控件放进 `FormField` 的回调，并使用回调传入的主题。这样标签、尺寸、禁用和错误状态才能正确关联到输入控件。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 修改标签和错误信息，查看它们在输入框周围的位置。
2. 点击标签，确认焦点进入输入框；再切换必填和禁用状态。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Build the input inside the `FormField` callback and use the theme passed to that callback. This connects the label and passes size, disabled and error state to the input.

### Try the preview

1. Change the label and error text to see where they appear.
2. Click the label to focus the input, then toggle required and disabled.

note.zh: Required 显示必填标记，不执行校验。需要检查输入值时，使用 Form.Validate 或应用自己的校验逻辑。
note.en: Required displays a required marker without validating the value. Use Form.Validate or application validation to check input.

body: nui.FormField(c.Key("field"),t,nui.FormFieldOptions{Label:{{label}},Help:"Use a name your team will recognize.",Required:{{required}},Disabled:{{disabled}},Error:{{error}},Size:{{size}}},func(ft nui.Theme){nui.Input(c.Key("input"),ft,&s.Value,nui.InputOptions{Placeholder:"Project name"})})

description.zh: 把相关输入框和按钮连成一组。
description.en: Join related inputs and buttons into one group.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

通过 FieldGroupItem 列表提供内容，每项包含稳定 ID 和 Build 回调。组统一处理尺寸、禁用和外侧圆角，组内仍保留各控件的键盘顺序。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 在搜索框输入文字，再切换纵向排列。
2. 调整尺寸或开启禁用，查看输入框和按钮一起变化。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Provide FieldGroupItems with stable IDs and Build callbacks. The group coordinates size, disabled state and outer corners while keeping each control’s keyboard order.

### Try the preview

1. Type in the search field, then switch to vertical layout.
2. Change size or enable disabled to see both controls update.

note.zh: Search 按钮只展示组合方式，未执行搜索。Build 回调只创建当前界面，搜索任务应由点击回调启动。
note.en: The Search button demonstrates composition without running a search. Build only creates the current UI; start searching from a click callback.

name: Checkbox

description.zh: 勾选单个选项，也可表示部分选中的状态。
description.en: Toggle an option or represent a partially selected state.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

Checkbox 绑定 `*bool`。需要表示一组子项只选了一部分时，使用 CheckboxTri 和 CheckState，值为 Unchecked、Checked 或 Indeterminate。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 点击上方复选框，查看 Enabled 的 true / false 变化。
2. 点击下方 Mixed selection，观察部分选中如何变为选中，再切换禁用。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Checkbox binds a `*bool`. Use CheckboxTri with CheckState when only some child items are selected: Unchecked, Checked or Indeterminate.

### Try the preview

1. Click the first checkbox and watch Enabled switch between true and false.
2. Click Mixed selection to change the mixed state to checked, then try disabled.

note.zh: 选择值应保存在视图函数外。父子复选框之间的联动由应用计算。
note.en: Keep selection values outside the view function. The application computes relationships between parent and child checkboxes.

body:
nui.Checkbox(c.Key("toggle"),t,&s.Value,nui.CheckboxOptions{Label:{{label}},Description:"Updates are saved locally in this example.",Color:{{color}},Size:{{size}},Disabled:{{disabled}},Loading:{{loading}}})
ui.Textf(c,"Enabled: %t",s.Value)
nui.CheckboxTri(c.Key("tri"),t,&s.Mixed,nui.CheckboxTriOptions{CheckboxOptions:nui.CheckboxOptions{Label:"Mixed selection",Disabled:{{disabled}}}})

name: Switch

description.zh: 打开或关闭一项设置。
description.en: Turn a setting on or off.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

Switch 绑定一个 `bool` 值，通过指针读写开关状态。需要保存设置时，在 OnChange 中处理；文件读写等耗时操作应放到后台。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 点击开关，查看下方 Enabled 的变化。
2. 开启加载或禁用，尝试再次切换。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Switch reads and updates a `bool` through a pointer. Handle OnChange to save a setting, and move slow work such as file access to a background task.

### Try the preview

1. Toggle the switch and check Enabled below it.
2. Enable loading or disabled and try toggling it again.

note.zh: 加载和禁用都会阻止切换。本例只保留当前预览中的值，不会写入设置文件。
note.en: Loading and disabled both prevent toggling. This example keeps its value only in the current preview and does not write a settings file.

body:
nui.Switch(c.Key("toggle"),t,&s.Value,nui.SwitchOptions{Label:{{label}},Description:"Updates are saved locally in this example.",Color:{{color}},Size:{{size}},Disabled:{{disabled}},Loading:{{loading}}})
ui.Textf(c,"Enabled: %t",s.Value)

description.zh: 从一组可见选项中选择多项。
description.en: Choose multiple items from a visible set of options.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

CheckboxGroup 绑定选中值的切片，例如 `[]string`。每个 Option 的 Value 保存业务值，Label 用于显示；Value 必须唯一，名称可以重复。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 勾选两种语言，查看下方 Selected 列表。
2. 切换横向排列或调整尺寸，确认选择仍保留。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

CheckboxGroup binds a slice of selected values, such as `[]string`. Each Option uses Value for application data and Label for display. Values must be unique; labels may repeat.

### Try the preview

1. Select two languages and check the Selected list.
2. Change layout or size and confirm that the selections remain.

note.zh: 选中值和选项数据都由应用保存。选项临时从列表消失时，组件不会自动清除对应的选中值。
note.en: The application owns both options and selection. An option temporarily missing from the list does not automatically remove its selected value.

description.zh: 从一组可见选项中选择一项。
description.en: Choose one item from a visible set of options.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

RadioGroup 绑定单个值，例如 `*string`。每个选项使用稳定且唯一的 Value；需要表示尚未选择时，可使用 Optional 或专门的空选项。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 选择一种语言，再选择另一种，查看 Selected 如何替换。
2. 用键盘方向键移动选项，再比较横向和禁用设置。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

RadioGroup binds one value, such as `*string`. Give every option a stable, unique Value. Use Optional or a dedicated empty option when no selection must be represented.

### Try the preview

1. Choose a language, then another, and watch Selected change.
2. Use arrow keys to move between options, then compare horizontal and disabled settings.

description.zh: 拖动滑块调整一个数值或一段范围。
description.en: Adjust a value or range by dragging sliders.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

Slider 绑定一个 `*float64`；RangeSlider 绑定最小值和最大值两个指针。设置 Min、Max 和 Step 控制范围及步长，值需要保存在视图函数外。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 拖动上方滑块，再拖动下方范围的两个端点。
2. 调整步长，用方向键查看每次变化的数值，再切换纵向。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Slider binds one `*float64`; RangeSlider binds two pointers for the lower and upper values. Min, Max and Step set the limits and increment. Keep the values outside the view function.

### Try the preview

1. Drag the upper slider, then both ends of the range below it.
2. Change the step and use arrow keys to compare increments, then try vertical layout.

note.zh: 本例范围为 0–100。OnChange 报告实时变化；需要在拖动结束后处理结果时，可使用 OnCommit。
note.en: This example uses a 0–100 range. OnChange reports live changes; use OnCommit to handle a completed adjustment.

name: Select

description.zh: 打开下拉列表，选择一个或多个值。
description.en: Choose one or more values from a dropdown list.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

单选使用 `Select` 并绑定一个值，多选使用 `SelectMultiple` 并绑定值的切片。Option.Value 保存选中值，Label 显示名称，两者可以不同。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 打开上方单选列表，用鼠标或方向键选择语言。
2. 在下方多选列表中选择两项，再调整尺寸和样式。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Use `Select` with one bound value or `SelectMultiple` with a slice of values. Option.Value is the selected application value, while Label is the displayed name.

### Try the preview

1. Open the upper single-select list and choose a language with the mouse or arrow keys.
2. Select two items in the lower list, then change size and variant.

note.zh: 更改外观会保留选中值。应用需要空选择时，应明确设计空值，不要假定字符串空值一定表示未选择。
note.en: Appearance changes retain selected values. Model an empty selection explicitly rather than assuming an empty string always means no selection.

body:
nui.Select(c.Key("select"),t,&s.Value,[]nui.Option[string]{{Value:"go",Label:"Go"},{Value:"rust",Label:"Rust"},{Value:"typescript",Label:"TypeScript"}},nui.SelectOptions{Label:"Language",Placeholder:{{placeholder}},Color: {{color}}, Size: {{size}}, Variant: {{variant}},Disabled:{{disabled}}})
ui.Textf(c,"Selected: %s",s.Value)
nui.SelectMultiple(c.Key("multiple"),t,&s.Many,[]nui.Option[string]{{Value:"go",Label:"Go"},{Value:"rust",Label:"Rust"},{Value:"typescript",Label:"TypeScript"}},nui.SelectOptions{Label:"Multiple languages",Placeholder:"Select several",Color: {{color}}, Size: {{size}}, Variant: {{variant}},Disabled:{{disabled}}})

name: InputMenu

description.zh: 在输入框中搜索，并从候选项中选择。
description.en: Search in an input and select from its suggestions.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

InputMenu 使用 SearchState 保存搜索草稿和选择结果：Query 是输入文字，Selected 是单选 ID，多选时使用 SelectedValues。状态放在视图函数外，避免更新界面时丢失输入。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 输入语言名称的一部分，从候选列表选择一项。
2. 开启多选，再选择另一项，使用标签上的 × 移除选择。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

InputMenu uses SearchState for the query and selection: Query holds typed text, Selected holds a single ID, and SelectedValues holds multiple IDs. Keep the state outside the view function.

### Try the preview

1. Type part of a language name and select a suggestion.
2. Enable multiple selection, add another item, then remove one using its × button.

note.zh: 普通输入变化使用 OnChange；确认候选项使用 OnSelect。需要允许提交列表之外的文字时，显式开启 AllowCustom。
note.en: Use OnChange for query edits and OnSelect for suggestion activation. Enable AllowCustom to submit text that is not in the list.

body: nui.InputMenu(c.Key("menu"),t,&s.Search,[]nui.Option[string]{{Value:"go",Label:"Go"},{Value:"rust",Label:"Rust"},{Value:"typescript",Label:"TypeScript"}},nui.InputMenuOptions{InputOptions:nui.InputOptions{Label: {{label}}, Placeholder: {{placeholder}}, Color: {{color}}, Size: {{size}}, Variant: {{variant}}, Disabled: {{disabled}}, ReadOnly: {{readOnly}}, Loading: {{loading}}},Multiple:{{multiple}}})

description.zh: 在按钮等控件旁打开补充内容。
description.en: Open related content beside a button or other control.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

先创建触发控件，再把它和保存打开状态的 `*bool` 传给 Popover。内容回调接收面板主题，用它创建说明、输入框或按钮。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 点击触发按钮打开面板，点击 Close 关闭。
2. 展开全部参数，将 Mode 设为 PopoverHover，尝试悬停打开和移开关闭。
3. 调整 Placement 或延迟；网站延迟单位为毫秒，2000 表示 2 秒。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Create a trigger, then pass it and a persistent `*bool` open value to Popover. Build text, inputs or buttons using the theme passed to the content callback.

### Try the preview

1. Click the trigger to open the panel, then Close to dismiss it.
2. Expand All fields, set Mode to PopoverHover, and try opening and closing it by hovering.
3. Adjust Placement or delays. Delay controls use milliseconds, so 2000 means 2 seconds.

note.zh: OpenDelay / CloseDelay 只用于悬停模式。MaxHeight 限制高度，不自动滚动；MatchAnchor 将触发控件宽度作为最小宽度。Label 只设置辅助技术名称。Dismissible=false 阻止 Escape 和外部点击关闭，面板内的 Close 仍可关闭。
note.en: OpenDelay and CloseDelay apply only to hover mode. MaxHeight limits height without adding scrolling; MatchAnchor uses the trigger width as a minimum. Label names the panel for assistive technology. Dismissible=false blocks Escape and outside-click dismissal, while Close still works.

label.zh: 允许 Escape 或外部点击关闭
label.en: Dismiss with Escape or outside click

description.zh: 让超出显示区域的内容可以滚动。
description.en: Scroll content that exceeds the visible area.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

将长内容放入 ScrollArea，并给返回的外层元素设置高度、Fill 或 Grow，明确可用空间。Direction 可选择纵向、横向或双向滚动。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 在预览内滚动，查看 30 条示例记录。
2. 调整滚动条宽度，比较拖动区域。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Build long content inside ScrollArea and set Height, Fill or Grow on the returned wrapper to define its available space. Direction selects vertical, horizontal or both-axis scrolling.

### Try the preview

1. Scroll inside the preview to browse the 30 sample records.
2. Change the scrollbar width and compare the drag area.

note.zh: 滚动条宽度为 0 时使用 MyGo 默认宽度，不会隐藏滚动条。大量数据可改用 Listbox 或 Table 的虚拟列表。
note.en: A scrollbar width of 0 uses the MyGo default; it does not hide the scrollbar. For large datasets, consider the virtual lists in Listbox or Table.

description.zh: 悬停或键盘聚焦时显示简短说明。
description.en: Show a short explanation on hover or keyboard focus.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

把当前构建中的控件作为 anchor 传给 Tooltip，再设置提示文字。Kbds 可附加快捷键提示；Tooltip 不接收点击或额外焦点。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 将指针停在按钮上，等待提示出现。
2. 用 Tab 聚焦按钮，再试试禁用提示。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Pass a control from the current build as the Tooltip anchor and provide its text. Kbds adds key hints. The tooltip itself does not accept clicks or extra focus.

### Try the preview

1. Hover over the button and wait for its tooltip.
2. Focus the button with Tab, then try disabling the tooltip.

note.zh: 鼠标悬停默认延迟 600ms，键盘聚焦立即显示。多行说明或可点击内容应使用 Popover，关键操作说明还应出现在可见界面中。
note.en: Mouse hover has a default 600ms delay; keyboard focus shows the tip immediately. Use Popover for multiline or interactive content, and keep essential instructions visible elsewhere.

description.zh: 在对话框中完成编辑或确认操作。
description.en: Complete an edit or confirmation in a modal dialog.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

用一个持久的 `bool` 保存打开状态，传给 ModalWithOptions。Title 和 Description 设置标题与说明，内容回调用于构建正文。每次构建都调用组件，包括关闭时。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 点击 Open dialog，输入项目名称，再点击 Save 关闭。
2. 重新打开，确认输入仍保留；再按 Escape 关闭。
3. 分别将 Dismissible 和 CloseButton 设为否，比较关闭方式。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Keep a persistent `bool` open value and pass it to ModalWithOptions. Title and Description set the heading, and the content callback builds the body. Call the component on every build, including when closed.

### Try the preview

1. Click Open dialog, enter a project name, then click Save to close it.
2. Open it again to check that the input remains, then close with Escape.
3. Set Dismissible and CloseButton to No separately and compare dismissal options.

note.zh: Dismissible 控制 Escape 和遮罩点击，CloseButton 控制关闭按钮。两项都设为 false 才能关闭这些默认关闭方式。本例的 Save 只关闭对话框，不保存到文件或服务端。
note.en: Dismissible controls Escape and backdrop clicks; CloseButton controls the close button. Set both to false to disable these dismissal methods. Save only closes this example; it does not persist data.

label.zh: 允许 Escape 或外部点击关闭
label.en: Dismiss with Escape or outside click

name: Slideover

description.zh: 从窗口边缘打开详情或编辑面板。
description.en: Open a detail or editing panel from a window edge.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

Slideover 通过 `*bool` 控制打开状态，Side 选择边缘，Extent 设置宽度或高度。标题、正文和底部操作区的用法与 Modal 相似。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 点击 Open panel，查看面板从当前边缘滑入。
2. 用 Done 关闭，再切换 Side，比较不同方向。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Control Slideover with a `*bool` open value, choose an edge with Side, and set width or height with Extent. The title, body and footer work similarly to Modal.

### Try the preview

1. Click Open panel and watch it slide in from the selected edge.
2. Close it with Done, change Side, and compare another direction.

note.zh: 预览中的面板限制在预览框内。关闭时应继续调用 Slideover，让退出动画和焦点恢复完成。
note.en: The panel is confined to the preview frame. Keep calling Slideover during closing so its exit animation and focus restoration can finish.

label.zh: 允许 Escape 或外部点击关闭
label.en: Dismiss with Escape or outside click

body:
nui.Button(c.Key("open"),t,"Open panel",nui.ButtonOptions{}).OnClick(func(){s.Open=true})
nui.Slideover(c.Key("panel"),t,&s.Open,nui.SlideoverOptions{ModalOptions:nui.ModalOptions{Title:{{label}},Dismissible:{{dismissible}}},Side:{{side}}},func(t nui.Theme){ui.Text(c,"Keep the main view in context.");nui.Button(c.Key("close"),t,"Done",nui.ButtonOptions{}).OnClick(func(){s.Open=false})})

name: Toast

description.zh: 短暂显示操作结果，不要求用户立即处理。
description.en: Briefly show the result of an action.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

每个窗口先创建 ToastViewport，再在点击或任务完成后的 UI 处理中调用 Toast。Title、Description 和 Color 说明结果，Actions 可以提供撤销等操作。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 点击 Show notification，查看通知出现并在约 4 秒后消失。
2. 更改标题和颜色，再次发布通知。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Create one ToastViewport per window, then call Toast from a click action or UI handling for a completed task. Use Title, Description and Color for the result, and Actions for options such as Undo.

### Try the preview

1. Click Show notification and watch it disappear after about four seconds.
2. Change the title and color, then show another notification.

note.zh: 本例将超时设为 4 秒，组件默认是 5 秒。更改参数影响下一条通知；不要在每次视图构建时无条件发布通知。
note.en: This example sets a four-second timeout; the component default is five seconds. Parameter edits affect the next notification. Do not publish unconditionally on every view build.

body: nui.Button(c.Key("notify"),t,"Show notification",nui.ButtonOptions{}).OnClick(func(){nui.Toast(c,t,nui.ToastOptions{Title:{{label}},Description:"The example stays entirely in your browser.",Color:{{color}},Timeout:4*time.Second})})

description.zh: 点击按钮后，从菜单中选择操作。
description.en: Choose an action from a button’s dropdown menu.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

为菜单保存 MenuState，每个 MenuItem 使用唯一 ID，并在 OnSelect 中处理操作。把按钮作为锚点传给 DropdownMenu，组件负责打开、关闭和焦点恢复。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 点击按钮打开菜单，选择 Edit 或 Duplicate，查看下方操作名称。
2. 开启禁用，确认 Archive 项不能选择。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Keep a MenuState, give each MenuItem a unique ID, and handle its action in OnSelect. Pass a button as the DropdownMenu anchor to get opening, dismissal and focus restoration.

### Try the preview

1. Open the menu and choose Edit or Duplicate, then check the action name below it.
2. Enable disabled and confirm that Archive cannot be selected.

note.zh: 禁用参数只作用于本例的 Archive 项。菜单选择只记录操作，不修改真实数据。
note.en: The disabled control affects only Archive in this example. Menu actions are recorded without changing real data.

description.zh: 右键点击内容时显示相关操作。
description.en: Show actions for content on right-click.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

ContextMenu 使用可聚焦区域作为锚点，并保存独立的 MenuState。MenuItem.OnSelect 处理选择结果；也支持 Menu 键和 Shift+F10 打开。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 在预览按钮上点击右键，选择 Edit 或 Duplicate。
2. 查看下方结果，再开启禁用检查 Archive 项。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Use a focusable area as the ContextMenu anchor and keep a separate MenuState. Handle selections with MenuItem.OnSelect. The Menu key and Shift+F10 can also open it.

### Try the preview

1. Right-click the preview button and choose Edit or Duplicate.
2. Check the result below, then enable disabled and inspect Archive.

note.zh: 本例只记录选择结果，不执行文件操作。浏览器或系统可能占用部分键盘快捷键。
note.en: This example only records the chosen action and does not operate on files. The browser or operating system may reserve some keyboard shortcuts.

description.zh: 在一组相关内容面板之间切换。
description.en: Switch between related content panels.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

为每个 TabItem 设置稳定 ID、Label 和 Content，用 `*string` 保存当前选中的 ID。默认只构建当前面板；需要保留隐藏控件的编辑状态时，可设置 KeepMounted。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 切换 Overview 和 Settings，查看对应正文。
2. 开启下划线样式或纵向排列，再用方向键切换。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Give each TabItem a stable ID, Label and Content, and keep the selected ID in a `*string`. Only the active panel is built by default. Use KeepMounted when hidden controls need to retain their editing state.

### Try the preview

1. Switch between Overview and Settings and check their content.
2. Try underline or vertical layout, then navigate with arrow keys.

note.zh: 业务数据始终由应用保存。KeepMounted 保留隐藏控件，但隐藏内容的构建回调仍会执行。
note.en: The application always owns its data. KeepMounted retains hidden controls, but their build callbacks still run.

name: Collapsible

description.zh: 按需展开或收起一个内容区域。
description.en: Expand or collapse a single section.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

用 `*bool` 保存展开状态，在正文回调中创建内容。Label 设置触发按钮的文字，Disabled 阻止用户切换。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 点击标题，展开后再点击收起。
2. 比较禁用和保留内容选项。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Store the open state in a `*bool` and build the body in the content callback. Label names the trigger and Disabled prevents toggling.

### Try the preview

1. Click the heading to expand, then click it again to collapse.
2. Compare disabled and keep-content settings.

note.zh: KeepMounted 保留隐藏控件的局部状态，但仍执行内容回调。是否保留业务数据由应用决定，不应依赖控件是否显示。
note.en: KeepMounted retains local state for hidden controls while still running their content callback. Keep application data independently of whether a control is visible.

body: nui.Collapsible(c.Key("collapsible"),t,&s.Open,nui.CollapsibleOptions{Label:{{label}},Disabled:{{disabled}},KeepMounted:{{keepMounted}}},func(t nui.Theme){ui.Text(c,"The hidden section is now expanded.")})

name: Accordion

description.zh: 用多个可折叠区域组织内容。
description.en: Organize content into several collapsible sections.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

Accordion 接收带唯一 ID 的项目列表，并通过 `*[]string` 保存展开项。Multiple 允许同时展开多项，Collapsible 控制单开模式下能否收起当前项。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 依次打开 Installation 和 Usage，查看默认单开行为。
2. 开启 Multiple 同时展开两项；关闭 Multiple 后，再关闭 Collapsible 试验收起行为。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Accordion takes items with unique IDs and stores open IDs in a `*[]string`. Multiple permits several open sections; Collapsible controls whether the open item can close in single-open mode.

### Try the preview

1. Open Installation and then Usage to see single-open behavior.
2. Enable Multiple to open both. Turn it off, then disable Collapsible and try closing the current item.

note.zh: 默认允许再次点击已展开项将其收起。Multiple 模式不受 Collapsible 限制。
note.en: By default, activating the open item again closes it. Collapsible does not restrict multiple-open mode.

body: nui.Accordion(c.Key("accordion"),t,&s.Open,[]nui.AccordionItem{{ID:"install",Label:"Installation",Content:func(c *ui.Context,t nui.Theme){ui.Text(c,"go get github.com/josexy/nuxt-ui-go")}},{ID:"usage",Label:"Usage",Content:func(c *ui.Context,t nui.Theme){ui.Text(c,"Create a window and pass a theme to components.")}}},nui.AccordionOptions{Multiple:{{multiple}},Disabled:{{disabled}},Collapsible:{{collapsible}}})

description.zh: 显示当前页面在导航层级中的位置。
description.en: Show the current page within a navigation hierarchy.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

按路径顺序提供 BreadcrumbItem，最后一项作为当前页，其余项通过 OnSelect 导航。MaxItems 限制显示数量，较长路径用省略号收起中间项。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 点击 Home 或 Projects，查看本地导航反馈。
2. 调整显示上限，观察路径中间的项目何时变为省略号。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Provide BreadcrumbItems in path order. The last item is the current page; other items navigate through OnSelect. MaxItems shortens long paths with an ellipsis.

### Try the preview

1. Click Home or Projects and check the local navigation feedback.
2. Change the visible limit and see when middle items become an ellipsis.

note.zh: 本例不切换真实页面。省略号只是路径提示，不能点击展开菜单。
note.en: This example does not change pages. The ellipsis is a path indicator and does not open a menu.

description.zh: 切换数据页，并显示当前页码。
description.en: Change data pages and show the current page number.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

Pagination 绑定从 1 开始的页码，Total 是总记录数，PageSize 是每页条数。应用在 OnChange 中根据新页码更新数据。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 点击页码或翻页按钮，查看下方当前页。
2. 调整相邻页数、翻页按钮和首尾页显示，比较页码排列。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Pagination binds a page number starting at 1. Total is the record count and PageSize is the number per page. Update application data from OnChange when the page changes.

### Try the preview

1. Click a page or navigation button and check the current page below.
2. Change siblings, navigation controls and edge pages to compare the layout.

note.zh: 本例有 100 条记录、每页 10 条。分页组件只改变页码，不会自动查询数据；零个相邻页使用 `SiblingCount: nui.Set(0)`。
note.en: The example has 100 records with 10 per page. Pagination changes the page number without fetching data. Use `SiblingCount: nui.Set(0)` for zero sibling pages.

description.zh: 展示流程步骤，并控制当前步骤。
description.en: Display a process and select its current step.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

用 StepItem 列表描述步骤，并通过 `*string` 保存当前步骤 ID。Linear 默认启用，允许返回和前进到下一步；CanSelect 可在切换时检查是否允许进入。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 依次点击 Details、Team 和 Review。
2. 关闭按顺序进行，尝试直接选择后面的步骤，再比较纵向排列。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Describe steps with StepItems and store the current ID in a `*string`. Linear is enabled by default, allowing backtracking or moving to the next step. CanSelect can reject a step change.

### Try the preview

1. Select Details, Team and Review in sequence.
2. Disable linear navigation and jump to a later step, then compare vertical layout.

note.zh: Stepper 不创建各步骤的表单，也不自动校验或提交。方向键只移动焦点，Enter 或 Space 才确认步骤。
note.en: Stepper does not create, validate or submit step forms. Arrow keys move focus; Enter or Space activates a step.

description.zh: 按顺序展示活动记录或里程碑。
description.en: Display activities or milestones in sequence.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

按显示顺序提供 TimelineItem，Title、Description 和 Time 都由应用填写。Current 使用从 0 开始的索引指定当前项，CurrentID 可改用稳定 ID。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 调整当前步骤，查看创建、构建、发布三项的进度样式。
2. 切换横向排列，再调整颜色和尺寸。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Provide TimelineItems in display order with application-supplied Title, Description and Time. Current selects an item by its zero-based index; CurrentID selects it by stable ID.

### Try the preview

1. Change the current step and compare the created, built and released items.
2. Switch to horizontal layout, then change color and size.

note.zh: 时间文字由应用格式化，Timeline 不会自动排序或转换时区。
note.en: The application formats time labels. Timeline does not sort items or convert time zones.

description.zh: 在页面内持续显示可关闭的消息。
description.en: Display a persistent, dismissible message within a page.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

Banner 使用 `*bool` 控制显示，Title 和 Description 说明消息。把它放在需要提示的内容区域，Actions 可以添加处理按钮。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 关闭通知条，确认该区域隐藏。
2. 点击 Show banner 重新显示，再修改标题和颜色。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Control Banner visibility with a `*bool` and describe the message with Title and Description. Place it in the relevant content area and use Actions for buttons.

### Try the preview

1. Close the banner and confirm that it disappears.
2. Click Show banner to restore it, then edit the title and color.

note.zh: Banner 不自动固定在窗口顶部。open 传 nil 时表示常驻，并隐藏关闭按钮。
note.en: Banner does not pin itself to the top of the window. A nil open pointer makes it permanent and hides the close button.

name: Error

description.zh: 显示失败原因，并提供重试操作。
description.en: Explain a failure and provide a retry action.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

使用 `ErrorView` 展示 Status、Title 和 Description，通过 OnRetry 处理重试。Actions 可替换默认操作区。函数名使用 ErrorView，避免与颜色常量 `nui.Error` 冲突。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 修改标题，查看错误说明的显示。
2. 点击重试，查看下方计数增加。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Use `ErrorView` for Status, Title and Description, and handle retries with OnRetry. Actions can replace the default action area. The name ErrorView avoids a conflict with the `nui.Error` color constant.

### Try the preview

1. Change the title and inspect the error display.
2. Click retry and watch the count increase.

note.zh: 本例不发起网络请求。ErrorView 只展示错误，真正的重试任务由应用启动。
note.en: This example does not make a network request. ErrorView displays the failure; the application starts the retry task.

body:
nui.ErrorView(c.Key("error"),t,nui.ErrorOptions{Status:"404",Title:{{label}},Description:"This example does not make network requests.",OnRetry:func(){s.Retries++}})
ui.Textf(c,"Retry attempts: %d",s.Retries)

name: Form

description.zh: 校验多个字段，并在通过后处理提交。
description.en: Validate fields and handle a successful submission.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

在应用中保存 FormState，用 FormField.Name / Value 注册字段。Validate 返回以字段名为键的错误，OnSubmit 接收通过校验的数据。提交按钮调用 `form.Submit`。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 清空项目名称，点击 Save project，查看必填错误和焦点。
2. 输入名称后再次提交，查看下方 Saved 结果。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Keep a FormState and register fields through FormField.Name and Value. Validate returns errors keyed by field name; OnSubmit receives validated values. Call `form.Submit` from the submit button.

### Try the preview

1. Clear the project name and click Save project to see the error and focus behavior.
2. Enter a name and submit again, then check the Saved result.

note.zh: 本例只更新页面内的结果文字。实际保存由应用实现；Required 标记本身不执行校验。
note.en: This example only updates the result text. Implement persistence in the application; a Required marker does not perform validation.

body:
nui.Form(c.Key("form"),t,&s.Form,nui.FormOptions{Label:"Project form",Disabled:{{disabled}},Validate:func(values nui.FormValues)nui.FormErrors{if strings.TrimSpace(values["name"])==""{return nui.FormErrors{"name":"Enter a project name"}};return nil},OnSubmit:func(values nui.FormValues){s.Status="Saved: "+values["name"]}},func(t nui.Theme){nui.FormField(c.Key("field"),t,nui.FormFieldOptions{Name:"name",Value:s.Name,Label:"Project name",Required:true},func(t nui.Theme){nui.Input(c.Key("name"),t,&s.Name,nui.InputOptions{Placeholder:"A new project"})});nui.Button(c.Key("submit"),t,"Save project",nui.ButtonOptions{}).OnClick(s.Form.Submit)})
ui.Text(c,s.Status)

name: InputNumber

description.zh: 输入数字，或使用按钮按步长增减。
description.en: Enter a number or adjust it by a fixed increment.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

InputNumber 绑定 `Optional[float64]` 数值，并用 `NumberState` 保存输入草稿。两者放在视图函数外，才能保留空值、尚未输完的负号等编辑状态。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 输入数值，或点击增减按钮；本例范围为 0–100。
2. 修改步长，再切换按钮方向，比较增减量和按钮排列。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

InputNumber binds an `Optional[float64]` value and uses `NumberState` for the editing draft. Keep both outside the view function to retain empty values and incomplete input such as a minus sign.

### Try the preview

1. Enter a number or use the increment buttons; this example allows 0–100.
2. Change the step and button orientation to compare increments and layout.

note.zh: Horizontal 将减号、数值、加号横向排列；Vertical 将两个按钮放在右侧。方向切换保留草稿和数值。
note.en: Horizontal places decrement, value and increment in a row. Vertical puts both buttons on the right. Switching orientation retains the draft and numeric value.

body: nui.InputNumber(c.Key("number"),t,&s.Value,&s.Number,nui.InputNumberOptions{InputOptions:nui.InputOptions{Label: {{label}}, Placeholder: {{placeholder}}, Color: {{color}}, Size: {{size}}, Variant: {{variant}}, Disabled: {{disabled}}, ReadOnly: {{readOnly}}, Loading: {{loading}}},Orientation:{{orientation}},Min:nui.Set(0.0),Max:nui.Set(100.0),Step:{{step}}})

name: InputTags

description.zh: 把输入的文字添加为标签，并支持移除。
description.en: Turn typed text into removable tags.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

InputTags 绑定 `[]string` 标签列表，并用 `TagsState` 保存尚未添加的文字。Enter 添加标签，标签上的 × 移除该项，MaxTags 设置数量上限。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 输入标签并按 Enter，再用 × 删除。
2. 开启粘贴添加，粘贴用逗号分隔的文字；调整标签上限后再次添加。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

InputTags binds a `[]string` list and keeps unsubmitted text in `TagsState`. Enter adds a tag, its × button removes it, and MaxTags limits the number of tags.

### Try the preview

1. Type a tag and press Enter, then remove it with ×.
2. Enable paste-to-add and paste comma-separated text. Change the tag limit and try adding more.

note.zh: 批量粘贴默认关闭；开启后默认只用逗号分隔。只读允许查看内容，禁止添加和删除。
note.en: Bulk paste is off by default. When enabled, it splits on commas unless configured otherwise. Read-only prevents adding and removing tags.

body: nui.InputTags(c.Key("tags"),t,&s.Values,&s.Tags,nui.InputTagsOptions{InputOptions:nui.InputOptions{Label: {{label}}, Placeholder: {{placeholder}}, Color: {{color}}, Size: {{size}}, Variant: {{variant}}, Disabled: {{disabled}}, ReadOnly: {{readOnly}}, Loading: {{loading}}},MaxTags:{{maximum}},AddOnPaste:{{paste}}})

description.zh: 按格输入验证码或固定长度的短文本。
description.en: Enter a verification code or other fixed-length text.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

PinInput 绑定字符串，并使用 `PinState` 保存编辑状态。Length 决定格数，Numeric 只允许 ASCII 数字，Mask 隐藏实际字符。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 输入几个字符，再点击已有字符所在的格子进行替换。
2. 开启仅数字或隐藏字符，比较输入限制与显示；重置后尝试粘贴完整验证码。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

PinInput binds a string and uses `PinState` for editing state. Length sets the number of slots, Numeric accepts only ASCII digits, and Mask conceals the characters.

### Try the preview

1. Enter a few characters, then click an occupied slot and replace its character.
2. Enable numeric or masked input to compare behavior. Reset, then try pasting a complete code.

note.zh: 多个格子共用一个真实编辑器，Tab 只进入一次。组件不发送短信，也不验证身份；完成回调为 OnComplete。
note.en: The slots share one editor and one Tab stop. The component does not send SMS messages or verify identity. Use OnComplete to handle complete input.

description.zh: 用整数星级选择评分。
description.en: Choose a whole-number star rating.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

InputRating 绑定一个整数，0 表示未评分，Max 决定最高分。Clearable 允许清零当前评分，ReadOnly 用于只展示已有评分。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 点击星星，查看下方评分数值。
2. 开启允许清空后再次点击当前评分，再比较只读与纵向排列。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

InputRating binds an integer: 0 means unrated and Max sets the highest score. Clearable allows resetting to zero; ReadOnly displays an existing rating without editing.

### Try the preview

1. Click a star and check the value below it.
2. Enable clearing and click the current rating again, then compare read-only and vertical layout.

note.zh: 当前支持整数评分，不支持半星。应用负责保存或提交评分。
note.en: Ratings use whole numbers; half stars are not supported. The application saves or submits the rating.

description.zh: 在直接显示的列表中选择一项或多项。
description.en: Select one or more items from a visible list.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

用 `[]string` 保存选中 ID，用 ListboxState 保存键盘高亮和滚动状态。每个 ListboxItem 需要唯一 ID，Label 用于显示文字。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 选择一种语言，再次点击它，观察默认的取消选择行为。
2. 开启多选，选择两项，并用方向键移动高亮。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Keep selected IDs in a `[]string` and keyboard highlight and scroll state in ListboxState. Each ListboxItem needs a unique ID and a display Label.

### Try the preview

1. Select a language, then select it again to try the default toggle behavior.
2. Enable multiple selection, choose two items and move the highlight with arrow keys.

note.zh: 默认 SelectionToggle 允许再次激活以取消；SelectionReplace 表示激活时替换选择。列表显示名可以重复，ID 必须唯一。
note.en: SelectionToggle allows deselection by activating an item again. SelectionReplace replaces the selection. Labels may repeat, but IDs must be unique.

description.zh: 在弹出的列表中搜索并选择项目。
description.en: Search and choose items in a popup list.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

SelectMenu 把触发按钮、搜索框和 Listbox 组合起来。用选中 ID 列表保存结果，SelectMenuState 保存打开状态、查询词和列表交互。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 打开菜单，输入语言名称并选择结果。
2. 开启多选或关闭搜索框，再比较加载状态。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

SelectMenu combines a trigger, search field and Listbox. Keep results in a list of selected IDs, and use SelectMenuState for open state, query and list interaction.

### Try the preview

1. Open the menu, search for a language and choose a result.
2. Enable multiple selection or hide the search field, then compare the loading state.

note.zh: 默认只搜索 Label，选择或关闭后重置查询词。需要远程搜索时，用 ExternalFilter 展示应用已经筛选的结果。
note.en: By default, search matches Label and the query resets after selection or dismissal. For remote search, use ExternalFilter with results prepared by the application.

description.zh: 在日历中选择单日或起止日期。
description.en: Choose a date or a date range from a calendar.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

Calendar 使用 DateSelection 保存起止日期，用 CalendarState 保存当前浏览月份和高亮日期。Range 开启范围选择，Min、Max 和 IsDateDisabled 限制可选日期。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 点击一天，查看选中状态。
2. 开启区间选择，先点击起点，再点击终点。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Calendar keeps selected dates in DateSelection and the displayed month and active date in CalendarState. Range enables date ranges; Min, Max and IsDateDisabled limit selectable dates.

### Try the preview

1. Click a date to select it.
2. Enable range selection, then choose a start and end date.

note.zh: 为了便于对照，本例将今天固定为 2026-11-02。实际应用可使用当前日期；范围不能跨越禁用日期。
note.en: The example fixes today at 2026-11-02 for repeatable comparisons. Applications can use the current date. A selected range cannot cross disabled dates.

name: InputDate

description.zh: 分段输入日期，也可打开日历选择。
description.en: Edit date segments or choose a date from a calendar.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

单日用 InputDate 绑定 `Optional[Date]` 和 DateInputState；日期范围用 InputDateRange 绑定 DateSelection 和 DateRangeInputState。状态分别保存有效日期和未完成的输入。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 编辑上方单日：用左右键切换年、月、日，上下键增减。
2. 编辑下方起止日期，再开启显示日历按钮，用日历选择。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Use InputDate with `Optional[Date]` and DateInputState for one date, or InputDateRange with DateSelection and DateRangeInputState for a range. These states keep valid dates separate from incomplete input.

### Try the preview

1. Edit the upper date: use Left/Right to move between segments and Up/Down to adjust them.
2. Edit the lower date range, then enable the calendar button and choose dates from the calendar.

note.zh: 日历默认关闭，ShowCalendar=true 开启，HideCalendar 优先关闭。分段输入不使用 Placeholder、Password、MaxLength；Style 的 editor 是首个分段。当前不支持分段撤销/重做、多历法或时区选择。
note.en: The calendar is off by default. ShowCalendar=true enables it and HideCalendar overrides it. Segmented input does not use Placeholder, Password or MaxLength; Style receives the first segment as editor. Segment undo/redo, multiple calendars and time-zone selection are not supported.

body:
nui.InputDate(c.Key("date"),t,&s.Value,&s.Date,nui.InputDateOptions{InputOptions:nui.InputOptions{Label: {{label}}, Color: {{color}}, Size: {{size}}, Variant: {{variant}}, Disabled: {{disabled}}, ReadOnly: {{readOnly}}, Loading: {{loading}}},ShowCalendar:{{showCalendar}}})
nui.InputDateRange(c.Key("range"),t,&s.Range,&s.RangeInput,nui.InputDateOptions{InputOptions:nui.InputOptions{Label:"Date range",Color:{{color}},Size:{{size}},Variant:{{variant}},Disabled:{{disabled}},ReadOnly:{{readOnly}},Loading:{{loading}}},ShowCalendar:{{showCalendar}}})

name: InputTime

description.zh: 分段输入时、分、秒，支持 12 或 24 小时制。
description.en: Edit hours, minutes and seconds in 12- or 24-hour format.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

InputTime 绑定 `Optional[ClockTime]`，TimeInputState 保存尚未输完的时间。TwelveHour 决定小时制，Seconds 决定是否显示秒；未指定小时制时跟随语言和系统区域设置。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 用左右键选择分段，用上下键调整；12 小时制下可用 A / P 选择上下午。
2. 切换小时制或隐藏秒，查看已有时间如何保留。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

InputTime binds an `Optional[ClockTime]`, while TimeInputState holds incomplete input. TwelveHour chooses the hour format and Seconds controls the seconds segment. An unset hour format follows language and regional preferences.

### Try the preview

1. Move between segments with Left/Right and adjust with Up/Down. In 12-hour mode, A/P selects AM or PM.
2. Switch hour format or hide seconds and check that the time is retained.

note.zh: 隐藏秒后再编辑时、分，原秒值仍保留。ClockTime 不含日期和时区。Placeholder、Password、MaxLength 不适用于分段输入；当前没有时间范围、分段撤销/重做或时区选择器。
note.en: Editing hours or minutes while seconds are hidden retains the seconds value. ClockTime has no date or time zone. Placeholder, Password and MaxLength do not apply to segmented input. Time ranges, segment undo/redo and a time-zone picker are not available.

body: nui.InputTime(c.Key("time"),t,&s.Value,&s.Time,nui.InputTimeOptions{InputOptions:nui.InputOptions{Label: {{label}}, Color: {{color}}, Size: {{size}}, Variant: {{variant}}, Disabled: {{disabled}}, ReadOnly: {{readOnly}}, Loading: {{loading}}},TwelveHour:{{twelveHour}},Seconds:{{seconds}}})

description.zh: 通过颜色面板、色板或数值选择颜色。
description.en: Choose a color from a panel, swatches or numeric values.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

ColorPicker 绑定 `ui.Color`，并用 ColorPickerState 保存交互状态。颜色面板、HEX 输入和 RGB 数值会同步到同一个颜色值。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 拖动颜色区域和滑条，查看颜色变化。
2. 编辑 HEX 或 RGB 数值，观察其他表示同步更新。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

ColorPicker binds a `ui.Color` and uses ColorPickerState for interaction state. The color panel, HEX input and RGB values all update the same color.

### Try the preview

1. Drag in the color panel and along the sliders.
2. Edit HEX or RGB values and watch the other representations update.

note.zh: 这里只改变示例选择的颜色，不改变网站主题。图片取色和屏幕取色尚未提供。
note.en: This changes the sample color, not the website theme. Picking colors from images or the screen is not provided.

description.zh: 按行列展示数据，支持排序、选择和滚动。
description.en: Display rows and columns with sorting, selection and scrolling.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

用 TableState.SetRows 设置数据，并为每行提供稳定 ID。TableColumn.Value 提供文字，Compare 定义排序，Cell 可自定义单元格。数据变化时更新 SetRows，不要在每次构建时重复初始化。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 点击 Project 列标题，比较升序和降序。
2. 选择数据行，再减小表格高度，尝试滚动。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Set data with TableState.SetRows and provide a stable ID for each row. TableColumn.Value supplies text, Compare defines sorting, and Cell customizes a cell. Update SetRows when data changes, not on every build.

### Try the preview

1. Click the Project header to compare ascending and descending order.
2. Select a row, then reduce table height and try scrolling.

note.zh: 排序后行位置会变化，编辑时应按行 ID 查找业务数据。Fixed 只禁止调宽和重排列，不会冻结滚动列。
note.en: Sorting changes row positions, so locate application data by row ID when editing. Fixed prevents resizing and reordering; it does not freeze a scrolling column.

description.zh: 展开层级数据，并选择其中的节点。
description.en: Expand hierarchical data and select its nodes.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

用 TreeState.SetNodes 设置节点，每个节点都有唯一 ID。Selection 保存选择，Outline.Open 保存展开项，Active 是键盘高亮。默认单选，点击行会选择并切换展开；方向键导航，Enter / Space 选择。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 点击父节点展开子项，再用键盘移动和选择。
2. 开启多选，比较 toggle 与 replace；replace 模式可用 Shift 扩展连续选择。
3. 切换层级缩进和父子联动，观察背景范围与选中项。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Set nodes with TreeState.SetNodes and give each node a unique ID. Selection holds selected IDs, Outline.Open holds expanded IDs, and Active is the keyboard highlight. By default, clicking a row selects and toggles expansion; arrows navigate and Enter/Space selects.

### Try the preview

1. Click a parent to expand it, then navigate and select with the keyboard.
2. Enable multiple selection and compare toggle with replace. Use Shift for a continuous range in replace mode.
3. Toggle nested layout and selection propagation to compare row backgrounds and selected items.

note.zh: 父子联动只处理已加载节点，禁用节点会阻断联动，后续加载的子节点不自动继承选择。Nested 默认显示层级竖线和缩进背景，关闭后背景占整行；两种布局都使用虚拟列表。懒加载结果要通过票据返回，SetExpanded 可使已折叠分支的旧结果失效。
note.en: Propagation covers loaded nodes only, stops at disabled nodes, and does not automatically select children loaded later. Nested draws hierarchy guides and inset backgrounds; disabling it gives rows full-width backgrounds. Both layouts use virtual lists. Return lazy-load results with tickets; SetExpanded can invalidate results for collapsed branches.

description.zh: 搜索应用命令，并从结果中执行操作。
description.en: Search application commands and run a result.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

先用 NewCommandIndex 创建命令索引，再交给 CommandPaletteState.SetIndex。索引在命令数据变化时更新，视图中调用 CommandPalette，OnSelect 处理选中的命令 ID。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 点击 Open commands，输入命令名称的一部分。
2. 用方向键选择结果并按 Enter，查看下方命令 ID。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Create a command index with NewCommandIndex and assign it with CommandPaletteState.SetIndex. Update the index when command data changes, render CommandPalette in the view, and handle the selected ID with OnSelect.

### Try the preview

1. Click Open commands and type part of a command name.
2. Choose a result with the arrow keys, press Enter, and check the command ID below.

note.zh: 本预览关闭了默认快捷键，避免与浏览器冲突。离开视图或关闭窗口时，应用应调用状态的 Close 方法取消搜索。
note.en: The preview disables the default shortcut to avoid browser conflicts. Call Close on the state when leaving the view or closing the window to cancel searches.

description.zh: 提供应用的主要导航和子级菜单。
description.en: Provide primary navigation and nested destinations.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

NavigationMenu 使用当前 ID 表示选中位置，NavigationState 保存子菜单交互。OnNavigate 通知应用切换页面，组件本身不加载页面内容或解析 URL。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 选择 Overview、Projects 或 Settings，查看当前 ID。
2. 开启纵向排列，再比较紧凑模式中的图标和提示。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

NavigationMenu uses an active ID for the current destination and NavigationState for submenu interaction. OnNavigate tells the application to switch pages; the component does not load content or resolve URLs.

### Try the preview

1. Choose Overview, Projects or Settings and check the active ID.
2. Enable vertical layout, then compare the icons and tooltips in compact mode.

note.zh: 每个导航项的 ID 在整棵树中必须唯一。父项用于展开子级，不同时执行导航。
note.en: Navigation IDs must be unique across the whole tree. A parent opens its children rather than navigating at the same time.

description.zh: 从底部打开面板，并用手柄调整高度。
description.en: Open a bottom panel and adjust its height with a handle.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

DrawerState.Open 控制打开，Snap 保存当前停靠位置。SnapPoints 是按从小到大排列的窗口高度比例；内容回调用于构建正文。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 点击 Open drawer，拖动顶部手柄，比较 50% 和 80% 两个高度。
2. 点击 Done 关闭，再试用 Escape 或向下拖动关闭。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

DrawerState.Open controls visibility and Snap stores the current stop. SnapPoints lists window-height proportions in ascending order. Build the panel body in the content callback.

### Try the preview

1. Click Open drawer and drag its top handle between the 50% and 80% height stops.
2. Close with Done, then try Escape or a downward drag.

note.zh: 本例使用 50% 和 80%，组件默认停靠点是 50% 和 85%。只有手柄用于拖动，正文继续正常滚动。关闭期间仍需调用组件。
note.en: This example uses 50% and 80% stops; the component defaults are 50% and 85%. Only the handle drags the panel, leaving the body available for scrolling. Keep rendering while it closes.

label.zh: 允许 Escape 或外部点击关闭
label.en: Dismiss with Escape or outside click

description.zh: 选择文件，并显示文件状态和上传进度。
description.en: Select files and display their status and upload progress.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

FileUploadState 保存文件列表和状态。桌面应用可用组件的文件选择器检查类型、大小和数量；实际传输由应用在 Begin / Report 对应的任务中实现。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 查看预置文件，点击移除按钮删除一项。
2. 点击重置示例恢复列表，再关闭允许移除。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

FileUploadState holds files and their status. Desktop applications can use the picker and validate type, size and count. Implement the actual transfer in application tasks using Begin and Report.

### Try the preview

1. Inspect the sample files and remove one with its remove button.
2. Reset the example to restore the list, then disable removal.

note.zh: 浏览器预览使用预置文件，关闭了 Interactive，不打开 MyGo 原生文件选择框，也不发起上传。应用需要自行实现传输，并在卸载或关窗时调用 Dispose 清理任务。
note.en: The browser preview uses sample files with Interactive disabled. It neither opens a MyGo native file picker nor uploads files. Implement transfers in the application and call Dispose when the view unmounts or the window closes.

description.zh: 用折线、柱状、面积或扇区图展示数据。
description.en: Display data as lines, bars, areas or slices.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

ChartState 保存图表数据，ChartOptions 决定图型和外观。分类数据用 SetCategories，数值轴用 SetData，时间轴用 SetTimeData；饼图和环形图用 SetSlices。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 切换六种图型，比较趋势图与占比图。
2. 点击图例隐藏或恢复一组数据，再调整网格和动画。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

ChartState stores data and ChartOptions controls chart type and appearance. Use SetCategories for categories, SetData for numeric X values, SetTimeData for time axes, and SetSlices for pie or donut charts.

### Try the preview

1. Switch between the six chart types to compare trends and proportions.
2. Click a legend item to hide or restore a series, then change grid and animation settings.

note.zh: 本例分别保存工作日系列数据和扇区数据。数据设置方法返回错误，应用应处理错误后再显示；状态由单个图表实例持有。
note.en: This example keeps weekday series and slice data separately. Data setters return errors that the application should handle. Keep each state with a single chart instance.

name: Carousel

description.zh: 在一组卡片中拖动或按页切换。
description.en: Drag or page through a set of cards.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

用 CarouselItem 提供带稳定 ID 的内容，CarouselState.Index 保存当前位置。Arrows 显示翻页按钮，Dots 显示位置圆点，Orientation 选择横向或纵向。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 在三张卡片间拖动，或开启箭头和圆点进行翻页。
2. 开启循环翻页，用按钮从最后一张回到第一张，再比较纵向排列。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Provide CarouselItems with stable IDs and keep the current position in CarouselState.Index. Arrows shows navigation buttons, Dots shows page dots, and Orientation chooses the axis.

### Try the preview

1. Drag between the three cards, or enable arrows and dots to change pages.
2. Enable wrap and use a button to go from the last card to the first, then compare vertical layout.

note.zh: Wrap 允许按钮、键盘和自动播放首尾循环，拖动仍有边界。内容回调可能为相邻项执行，不要在其中启动业务操作。
note.en: Wrap cycles button, keyboard and autoplay navigation between the ends, while dragging remains bounded. Adjacent items may also run their content callbacks; do not start application actions there.

body: nui.Carousel(c.Key("carousel"),t,&s.Carousel,[]nui.CarouselItem{{ID:"one",Label:"One",Build:func(c *ui.Context,t nui.Theme){nui.Card(c.Key("card"),t,nui.CardOptions{Title:"Design"},func(){ui.Text(c,"Start with a focused idea.")})}},{ID:"two",Label:"Two",Build:func(c *ui.Context,t nui.Theme){nui.Card(c.Key("card"),t,nui.CardOptions{Title:"Build"},func(){ui.Text(c,"Compose native Go components.")})}},{ID:"three",Label:"Three",Build:func(c *ui.Context,t nui.Theme){nui.Card(c.Key("card"),t,nui.CardOptions{Title:"Share"},func(){ui.Text(c,"Publish your work.")})}}},nui.CarouselOptions{Label:"Slides",Height:180,Orientation:{{orientation}},Arrows:{{arrows}},Dots:{{dots}},Wrap:{{wrap}}})

description.zh: 连续滚动展示文字或其他非交互内容。
description.en: Continuously scroll text or other display-only content.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

在 Marquee 的内容回调中放入展示元素，用 Speed 设置每秒移动距离，Reverse 改变方向，Active 控制是否运行。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 调整速度或反向选项，观察四个标签的移动。
2. 将指针移入区域暂停，移开继续；再关闭运行。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Put display elements in the Marquee content callback. Speed sets distance per second, Reverse changes direction, and Active controls whether it runs.

### Try the preview

1. Change speed or reverse to compare movement of the four labels.
2. Hover to pause and move away to resume, then turn Active off.

note.zh: 本例启用了悬停暂停。内容会重复构建，不要放入按钮、输入框或业务操作；系统减少动态效果时会停止移动。
note.en: This example enables pause on hover. Content is built repeatedly, so avoid buttons, inputs and application actions. Reduced-motion settings stop movement.

description.zh: 拖动分隔条，调整两个面板的大小。
description.en: Resize two panels by dragging their divider.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

Splitter 绑定一个 `float32` 值。默认单位为 DIP，Percent=true 时使用百分比；Vertical=true 改为上下分割，Min / Max 与绑定值使用相同单位。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 拖动分隔条，观察左右面板的比例。
2. 开启纵向，再尝试禁用分隔条。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Splitter binds a `float32` value in DIP, or a percentage when Percent=true. Vertical=true stacks the panels. Min and Max use the same units as the bound value.

### Try the preview

1. Drag the divider and compare the two panel sizes.
2. Enable vertical layout, then disable the divider.

note.zh: 本例按百分比限制在 15–85，避免任一面板完全消失。比例值应保存在视图函数外。
note.en: This example limits the percentage to 15–85 so neither panel disappears. Keep the value outside the view function.

name: Sidebar

description.zh: 为应用提供可收起、可调宽的侧边栏。
description.en: Add a collapsible, resizable application sidebar.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

Sidebar 组合头部、可滚动正文、底部和收起按钮。用 `collapsed` 保存桌面收起状态，SidebarState 保存调节后的宽度和窄窗口弹层状态，正文中可放入 NavigationMenu。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 拖动侧栏边缘调宽，双击边缘或点击 Reset width 恢复初始宽度。
2. 收起侧栏，悬停图标查看提示，选择 Settings 的子项，观察右侧当前页面。
3. 将断点设得比预览区域宽，点击出现的打开按钮，比较 Slideover、Modal 和 Drawer。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Sidebar combines a header, scrollable body, footer and toggle. Keep desktop collapse state in `collapsed`, and width and narrow-window open state in SidebarState. Build NavigationMenu in the body.

### Try the preview

1. Drag the sidebar edge to resize. Double-click it or use Reset width to restore the configured width.
2. Collapse the sidebar, hover its icons, and choose a Settings child to update the current page on the right.
3. Set the breakpoint wider than the preview, open the sidebar with its button, and compare Slideover, Modal and Drawer.

note.zh: 本例展开宽度默认 256 DIP，可调范围 160–360 DIP，收起宽 64 DIP。断点 0 始终使用桌面布局。初始宽度不会覆盖已经拖动得到的宽度，需要 Reset width 才会采用新值。导航后窄窗口面板默认关闭；保存到文件等持久化由应用处理。
note.en: The example starts at 256 DIP, allows 160–360 DIP, and collapses to 64 DIP. A zero breakpoint keeps desktop layout. Editing the initial width does not replace a user-resized width until Reset width is used. Narrow-window panels close after navigation by default; the application handles persistence.

label.zh: 切换弹层的宽度（0 关闭）

state:
Collapsed bool
Sidebar nui.SidebarState
Navigation nui.NavigationState
Active, Result string
setup:
s.Active="overview"
s.Result="Drag the sidebar edge to resize."

description.zh: 在内容区顶部显示标题、说明和主要操作。
description.en: Show a title, description and primary actions above the content.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

HeaderLayout 使用 Title 和 Description 显示页面信息，通过 Actions 回调添加按钮，也可在 Leading 区域放置内容。它显示在应用内容区，不修改系统标题栏。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 修改标题，查看标题和说明的排列。
2. 打开完整示例，查看 Actions 中如何添加 New project 按钮。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

HeaderLayout uses Title and Description for page information, Actions for buttons, and Leading for optional content. It sits in the application content area without changing the system title bar.

### Try the preview

1. Edit the title and inspect its layout with the description.
2. Open the complete example to see New project added through Actions.

note.zh: 示例按钮只展示布局。创建项目的动作需要应用自行绑定。
note.en: The sample button only demonstrates layout. Bind project creation in the application.

description.zh: 在内容区底部显示说明和次要操作。
description.en: Show explanatory text and secondary actions below the content.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

FooterLayout 通过 Text 显示页脚文字，Actions 回调提供帮助等次要操作。将它放在主内容区域下方，由外层布局决定位置。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 修改页脚文字，查看文字与 Help 按钮的排列。
2. 打开完整示例，查看如何在 Actions 中添加按钮。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

FooterLayout displays Text and uses Actions for secondary controls such as Help. Place it below the main content and let the parent layout position it.

### Try the preview

1. Change the footer text and compare its layout with the Help button.
2. Open the complete example to see a button added through Actions.

note.zh: 本例的 Help 按钮没有绑定操作。帮助页面或弹层由应用实现。
note.en: The Help button has no action attached. Provide the help page or popup in the application.

description.zh: 按栏目排列页脚链接。
description.en: Arrange footer links into columns.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

为每个 FooterColumn 及其链接设置稳定 ID，标题和 Items 决定显示内容。OnNavigate 接收选中链接的 ID，应用据此打开页面。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 点击页脚链接，查看下方返回的 ID。
2. 调整栏目最小宽度或缩窄窗口，观察栏目换行。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Give each FooterColumn and link a stable ID. Titles and Items define the displayed content. OnNavigate receives the selected link ID so the application can open the destination.

### Try the preview

1. Click a footer link and check the ID below it.
2. Change the minimum column width or narrow the window to see columns wrap.

note.zh: 本例只显示选择结果，不执行真实跳转。需要多层子菜单时，可使用 NavigationMenu。
note.en: This example shows the selected ID without navigating. Use NavigationMenu when nested submenus are needed.
